{{Top|leg}}
The '''emergency signal system''' was a special signaller bestowed upon by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Bersin Sekolah]] by the native [[Tasari]] who revered him and his efforts to return [[Tasariq]] to habitability. If activated, the signaller triggered a planet-wide search for Sekolah would be organized, starting at the last known location of the signal.<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|Tasariq: The Crystal Planet}}</ref>
